scenes.text: Be honest: is your YouTube Music Liked Songs a chaotic graveyard of thousands of tracks you never actually listen to?
Meet AutoOrganize. It automatically sorts your Liked Songs into clean, smart genre playlists, right inside your browser side panel.
It scans your library privately on your device. Zero passwords, no cookies lifted, and nothing is uploaded to the cloud.
Then, it auto-splits your music into real genre playlists using MusicBrainz. Unknowns stay uncategorized instead of guessed wrong.
Preview every track before anything happens. With one click, AutoOrganize creates the playlists right in your YouTube Music, and Google syncs them everywhere.

Best of all, no monthly subscriptions! Other playlist tools lock you into recurring monthly rent. AutoOrganize gives you a free preview and your first playlist free, with a one-time lifetime unlock forever.
Get it now on the Chrome Web Store and Microsoft Edge Add-ons, or reclaim your Liked Songs today at eight sixty-four zeros dot com.
